record.content: The Forest Service page, updated September 17, 2026, lists East Fork open with 133 sites, flush toilets, potable water, picnic tables, no electrical hookups, bear lockers, $35 fee, $10 extra vehicle, 14-day limit, 10 p.m.-6 a.m. quiet hours, maximum RV length 35 feet, 9,000-foot elevation, and weather-dependent operations.
